archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for High-End Editorial E-commerce
design_philosophy: A stark, minimalist, knowledge-focused aesthetic. 'Less AI generated' translates to an editorial, brutalist-leaning but highly refined layout. Using purely black backgrounds, stark white typography, and shades of grey for depth. Focus is entirely on the knowledge/books, using negative space generously.

rules: Headings must use Cormorant Garamond for a scholarly, authoritative, traditional Islamic knowledge feel.
Body text must use Manrope for high legibility.
Never center headings by default; prefer strong left-alignment to maintain the editorial grid.
Use extremely tight tracking on large headings, and very loose tracking on small uppercase labels.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-8, p-16, p-24. Do not cramp content.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Mode A 'Bento' grid for features/about. Asymmetrical layouts for book series showcases.
layout_and_spacing.containers: Avoid standard 'cards'. Use raw border grids (border-r, border-b) with no border-radius (rounded-none).
layout_and_spacing.nav_bar: Solid #050505 background with 1px border-b border-[#262626]. Must be sticky z-50.

components.buttons: Square edges (rounded-none). High contrast: bg-white text-black hover:bg-[#E5E5E5] transition-colors. For secondary buttons, use pure transparent background with 1px solid white border.
components.cards: Do not use standard Shadcn Cards with shadows. Use flat, rectangular `div` elements with `border border-[#262626] bg-[#0F0F0F]`. No border radius.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI but heavily customized: transparent background, 1px border-b only (no full border), rounded-none, white text.
components.images: All images must have a subtle grayscale filter (`grayscale-[50%]`) or be naturally dark to fit the aesthetic. Overlay hero images with `bg-black/40` to ensure text contrast.

motion.hover: Subtle opacity shifts. Links fade to 50% opacity on hover. Buttons scale slightly or change background instantly.
motion.page_load: Fade up elements softly (duration 0.5s). No bouncy spring animations.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use EXACTLY these URLs for the specified categories. Do NOT use placeholder text or services like via.placeholder.com. Ensure images have appropriate `alt` tags and fit within the aesthetic.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='purchase-button'`).
